 Print Actors Anil Kapoor and Shatrughan Sinha are neighbours, and their association in Hindi cinema goes back to the 1980s, when both appeared in Yudh. India Ke Top 1% The Anil Kapoor Show, the Bollywood star spoke warmly about their friendship and said he takes pride in having Sinha as his neighbour. The conversation came up during the Great Indian Budhi League special when Bihar’s Lalmani Srivastav introduced himself as the happiest man in the world and said people from his state are always happy. Kapoor replied with the saying, “Jo na kate aari se, woh kate Bihari se,” before praising Bihar’s talent and bringing up Sinha, who also hails from the state. Join conversation
